production_changes: Build short Huffman primary prefixes once, then duplicate contiguous prefixes to 512 entries.
Size distance symbols to 32 and buffered code-length symbols to 19, retaining literal capacity 288.
Fill distance-one streaming matches from the previous byte before the unchanged history/checksum machinery.
rejected_trials: bounded: early maximum-depth exit did not show a consistent setup benefit
rows: retained native16 length and zipped conversion did not show a consistent API benefit
excluded_timings: replicated-paired (8 processes): preserved source timestamp caused Cargo to reuse repeat-clean. Identical binary digests and fresh artifact output prove these are invalid candidate timings; replicated-invalid.json records identities. replica-paired is the corrected rebuild. Also exclude replica-paired and narrow-paired (16 processes): a standalone build log overwrote the frozen replica build log. replica-build-log-overwritten.json records the missing/replacement digests. Identical source hashes are rebuilt as prefix with unique logs; prefix-paired and prefix-narrow-paired replace those comparisons.

pipeline.scope: 3 warmups, 7 CPU-median batches; reader outputs <=65536 bytes use at least 64 iterations, other outputs below 4096 bytes at least 2048; separate untimed heap probe

metadata_caveat: Generic freeze scope text says 12 iterations, but outputs are deferred. Paired manifests and TSV iteration columns record the actual 3/minimums above.

linked_callers.batches: one warmup plus 11 retained alternating batches per version; median per version, then median across 3 processes

scopes.in-process: 212 PNG API operations; small512 iterations, large3; complete Png result blackboxed
scopes.repeat-focus: 9 exploratory streaming inflate operations; includes rejected bounded/rows snapshot
scopes.repeat-clean-focus: 9 isolated streaming inflate operations; verified repeat-clean reconstruction differs from baseline only in distance-one fill
scopes.fixed-focus: 6 PNG operations; RGB8 513x257 plain 128 iterations; RGBA8 4097x257 Stored 12 iterations; investigates controls from the broad caller

setup_callers.fixtures: Complete comb trees with maximum depth 1..15; construction blackboxed with identical private benchmark wrappers appended only to verified standalone source copies.

versions.replication: baseline vs prefix source (originally recorded as replica); exact source identity confirmed by rebuilt prefix snapshot. Measured driver preserved as replication-measured.py; corrected reproduction driver uses a unique log filename.

identity: Frozen source, harness, toolchain, commands, logs, executable and measurements hashed. Audit additionally requires an actual PNG library rebuild for every valid frozen checkpoint.
known_answers: Encoded-input fingerprints match across versions. Full scalar-modeled filtered bytes and native samples/palettes checked outside pipeline timings; linked callers check complete native sample/palette answers. Repeated-byte streams verify complete output and exact consumption before timing.
machine: Windows thread-cycle counts; current thread pinned to CPU2; same release/bench profile; no builds/tests from this task during timed runs. Host, other tasks, frequency and cache state are uncontrolled.
metric_changes: working_memory_bytes truthfully decreases with the 512-byte object reduction; heap allocation calls, reallocations and requested byte counts are independently checked.
independent_tests: Existing integration/support/fixture/oracle inputs unchanged. Release includes all 6 optional C audits; debug omits those 6 optional checks. Existing strict Rust distance/window policy remains distinct from known C zlib permissiveness.
failed_infrastructure: Initial installer-named setup executable was not launched (WinError 740); renamed standalone executable. First replication standalone compile exposed unsupported const range indexing; split_at_mut fixes it. Failed artifacts retained without performance claims.
